title: Length bound for a dropped slice
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $k$ and any bit string $z$, encode the first component of the total pair decoding of $z$ together with the suffix of its second component obtained by dropping $a(|\pi_1(z)|+1)^k$ bits. The resulting bit string has length at most $\max(|z|,2)$.
